text:
maria: Heads-up — customer demo tonight 18:00-20:00 PDT needs 4x A100s in us-west2. Can procurement/vendor confirm availability and any PO/lead time? Also want preemptible fallback.
cheng: Which model + sequence length? might affect per-slot memory.
devon: If it's a 70B with long context we should reserve full A100s, otherwise a40s could work. what's the model size?
maria: 34B, usually 8k context. prefer A100s.
anna: We have a soft claim in demo-pool for 2x A100 until 17:30 — can extend if finance OK. I'll try to borrow the extra two.
procurement-bot: Vendor portal shows 2 immediate A100s in us-west2; additional 2 available from vendor-acme with 2-3 hour lead (requires PO). Link: https://vendor-portal.example/slots/awst-usw2
vendor-acme: Hi team — we can hold 2 A100s for 2h on a tentative hold, PO required to finalize. If you need shorter lead, we can route to us-west1 (1hr) but cross-region latency may affect demo.
maria: @vendor-acme can you do a 2h tentative hold? we'll start PO now. please confirm hold id.
vendor-acme: Hold created: HOLD-8921. Expires 2h. Please send PO ref to ops@vendor-acme.com.
devon: Re: fallback — can we run with 2x A100 + 2x p4d (or A40) with model auto-quantize? quality might dip but demo still ok. cc @maria
cheng: Quick terraform to claim from demo-pool (if anna can extend):
```
module "claim" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood/alloc-claim.git//modules/slot-claim"
  region = "us-west2"
  sku = "a100"
  count = 2
}
```
anna: I'll extend the demo-pool claim for 60m and kick the TF apply if you give thumbs. react :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup: Do it. Also starting PO, pinging finance for fast approval.
procurement-bot: Finance fast-track requested (ticket FIN-1229). ETA approval ~45min.
devon: If finance stalls, plan B is 2x local A100 + 2x rented p4d in us-west1. I'll prepare routing policy in case we need to split region.
maria: Thanks all. @vendor-acme pls email HOLD-8921 details to ops@redwood and cc procurement. I'll report back once PO done.
vendor-acme: Will do. GL on the demo :wave: 
anna: applying terraform now, will post success or error here.
anna: apply done — claim succeeded, demo-pool extended. (reacted :white_check_mark: by maria)
maria: Perfect. I'll update customer and leave this thread open for PO status.
procurement-bot: PO submitted to vendor-acme (ref PO-3489).
maria: Closing once vendor confirms invoice. thanks everyone.
